basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support II (Physiology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Physiology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur, has invited applications for one contractual post of Project Technical Support-II (Accountant) under the ICMR-funded FOT project, on Rs. 20,000 per month plus HRA as admissible (total Rs. 24,000 per month including 20% HRA), with tenure till 19 December 2026. The essential qualification is a bachelor's degree in Commerce, BBA, BCA, Computer Engineering/Computer Science or an equivalent relevant discipline, with a Tally certificate and six months' experience. Candidates fill the Google Form and send a hard copy by 26

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 28 years, subject to relaxation as per applicable Government of India/ICMR rules. Age and qualifications are counted as of the last date of applications. The upper age limit is relaxable by five years for SC/ST candidates and three years for OBC candidates. Additional relaxation may be considered for candidates with adequate relevant project/accounts experience, as permissible under the applicable rules.

how_to_apply: Submit the duly completed application through the online Google Form: https://forms.gle/HZrAkvjAm5f2xWc67
Download the prescribed application form from the official website of AIIMS Nagpur.

Send a hard copy of the application with one set of self-attested photocopies of the required documents to: Dr. Smita R Sorte, Room No. 118, Department of Physiology, First Floor, Medical College Building, AIIMS Nagpur, MIHAN, Khapri, Nagpur - 441108, Maharashtra.
Complete both steps by 26 November 2026, 5 pm. The Google Form and applications received after the notified closing date will not be considered.
A valid email address and mobile number are compulsory. For queries, candidates may email Dr. Smita R. Sorte at [email protected].
Applicants must bring one recent passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested photocopies of the following, arranged in this sequence:
Proof of identity: Aadhaar Card, Driving License or any other valid government-issued photo identity card.
Proof of date of birth: Birth Certificate, Class 10 Board Certificate or Aadhaar Card.
Class 12 mark sheet and passing certificate.
B.Com. mark sheets for all years/semesters and degree certificate.
M.Com., MBA (Finance) or equivalent higher-qualification mark sheets and degree certificate, if applicable.
Experience certificates arranged chronologically, beginning with the oldest and ending with the most recent. The certificate should clearly state the nature of work during the period of employment.
Any other relevant certificates or testimonials supporting the information in the application.

Reserved category candidates must produce their latest Caste Validity Certificate. OBC candidates must have a latest valid non-creamy layer certificate in Form No. 10 format of the Government of India for the current financial year. PWD candidates must produce the latest disability certificate issued by a medical board of a Government hospital, with not less than 40% disability. All the above documents must also be brought in original for verification at the written test/interview.
important_instructions: Failure to bring original certificates to the written test/interview will result in disqualification from consideration. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview or personal discussion; candidates must arrange transport and accommodation themselves. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Wrong or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage. Selected persons have no claim to a regular post at AIIMS Nagpur or ICMR, or to continuation in any other project. The appointee may be relieved with one-month prior notice; failing this, the appointee may be held responsible for paying one-month salary. The principal investigator reserves the right to terminate the contract with one month's notice period. If the project is stalled or postponed, the salary may be delayed or stopped for that period. If the project/programme is not extended, the contract will be terminated without any notice. Once the project duration is completed, the tenure is automatically over. The interview date may change for administrative reasons; check https://aiimsnagpur.edu.in/recruitment before appearing.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is a medical institute at MIHAN, Khapri, Nagpur, Maharashtra. This notice is issued by its Department of Physiology and is signed by Dr. Smita R Sorte, Additional Professor, Department of Physiology, who is the Principal Investigator of the ICMR project. The post is a contractual project position, not a regular post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Tally certification: certificate of training in Tally Prime/Tally ERP 9 from a recognized training institute, with practical knowledge of accounting entries, ledger maintenance, voucher preparation and bank reconciliation. Experience: minimum six months of post-qualification experience in accounting, bookkeeping or financial management, including maintenance of accounts, bills, vouchers, cashbooks and expenditure records, in a government institution, academic institution, research project or recognized organization. Experience counts only after the essential educational qualification is acquired. Computer proficiency: working knowledge of accounting procedures, financial documentation and computer applications, particularly Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word. Experience in handling accounts of government-funded or externally funded research projects, including Utilization Certificates (UC), Statements of Expenditure (SoE), budget monitoring, financial reconciliation and maintenance of supporting vouchers. Familiarity with e-Office, Public Financial Management System (PFMS), Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and institutional financial procedures. Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and Marathi. Not exceeding 28 years, subject to relaxation as per applicable Government of India/ICMR rules. Age and qualifications are counted as of the last date of applications. The upper age limit is relaxable by five years for SC/ST candidates and three years for OBC candidates. Additional relaxation may be considered for candidates with adequate relevant project/accounts experience, as permissible under the applicable rules. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible to apply. Candidates currently employed must submit a No-Objection Certificate from their present employer. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com.), Business Administration (BBA), Computer Applications (BCA), Computer Engineering/Computer Science (B.E./B.Tech.), or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognized university/institution
rows.desirable: M.Com., MBA (Finance) or an equivalent higher qualification in Accounting/Finance

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA as admissible, a total of Rs. 24,000/- per month including 20% HRA. The tenure runs till 19 December 2026. The engagement may be extended up to 19 March 2027, subject to continuation of the post by ICMR, satisfactory performance and approval of the Competent Authority. The post is temporary. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim, Staff Quarters and other facilities applicable to regular ICMR staff are not admissible. Project staff are eligible for leave as per project recruitment rules and must give an undertaking before joining.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-II (Accountant) Job Description
content_sections.text: Maintain project cash book, ledger, budget-head-wise expenditure records, vouchers, bills, advances, settlements and other supporting financial documents. Prepare and compile Utilization Certificates, Statements of Expenditure, financial statements, budget estimates, expenditure summaries and fund-reconciliation statements. Scrutinize financial documents received from participating sites and coordinate correction, compilation and submission of site-wise financial records. Monitor sanctioned allocations, funds received, expenditure incurred, committed liabilities, available balances and re-appropriation/adjustment under approved budget heads. Assist the Principal Investigator in correspondence and coordination with ICMR, the AIIMS Nagpur Accounts Section, Administration and participating centres regarding financial and administrative matters. Maintain electronic and physical records of sanctions, approvals, procurement documents, salary records, participant-payment records, travel claims and audit-related documents. Facilitate audit, financial review, procurement, salary processing and timely submission of project reports and supporting documents. Perform data entry and other project-related administrative, financial or documentation work assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice announces an interview and a practical skill assessment in accounts on the interview day. The Institute may conduct a written/skill test if required. The Director and Appointing Authority has the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason. Meeting the essential qualification alone does not guarantee selection. Reporting and registration: 09:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Practical Skill Assessment (Accounts): 11 AM to 1 PM. Candidates should bring their own laptop for the exam. Interview: 3:00 PM onwards, subject to change depending on whether a written/skill test is conducted. Venue: Demonstration Room, First Floor Laboratory Block, Department of Physiology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur, MIHAN, Nagpur. The eligible/shortlisted applicants list and the results of the final selection list will be posted on the AIIMS website. The validity of the shortlist is one year from the date of publication of the result and renewable accordingly. The selected candidate must join within one week of the declaration of the result.
